flags.message: Forward-mode arrival cell for stay application 25A622, submitted to Justice Kagan on 2025-11-18, running on 2026-09-30 with the event still marked unresolved. A stay application is almost always disposed of within weeks, so the docket has very likely resolved and the corpus has not parsed the disposition (an unmatched resolution text, or a stale poll of this application). I did not retrieve the docket's later state or outcome; the forecast rests on the provisioned snapshot and priors only. Worth a repair/re-poll check on this application row.

No record/documents/ directory was provisioned (no application text). The underlying Ninth Circuit matter, No. 25-2374, is not in CourtListener's RECAP index, so the mandamus-posture reading rests on the caption (respondent is the District of Arizona) rather than on any filing.
